import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for source data
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_76/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_76/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_76/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: Student-level data
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'Student ID': int,
        'student_name': str,
        'gender': str,
        'grade': str,
        'school_name': str,
        'reading_score': int,
        'math_score': int
    })

    # Load Source 1: School-level data
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'School ID': int,
        'school_name': str,
        'type': str,
        'size': int,
        'budget': int
    })

    # Join student data with school data on 'school_name'
    # This is the natural join key because Source0 has school_name but no School ID,
    # and Source1 has school_name and School ID and other school info.
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on='school_name', how='left', validate='many_to_one')

    # Validate that all students matched a school
    if df_merged['School ID'].isnull().any():
        missing_schools = df_merged[df_merged['School ID'].isnull()]['school_name'].unique()
        raise ValueError(f"Some student records have school_name(s) not found in school data: {missing_schools}")

    # Reorder and rename columns to match target schema exactly
    # Target schema:
    # ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str, 'school_name': str,
    #  'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int, 'School ID': int, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]

    # Ensure correct dtypes (some may have been changed by merge)
    df_merged = df_merged.astype({
        'Student ID': int,
        'student_name': str,
        'gender': str,
        'grade': str,
        'school_name': str,
        'reading_score': int,
        'math_score': int,
        'School ID': int,
        'type': str,
        'size': int,
        'budget': int
    })

    # Select and order columns as per target schema
    df_target = df_merged[
        ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
         'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    ]

    # Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
